name: Hitozuma Joushi no Wakarasekata
original_name: 人妻上司の分からせ方
source:
Betrayed and discarded by the trusted boss whom he respected and even harbored faint feelings of admiration for, the protagonist was suddenly demoted and moved positions by her.

Rumors start to circulate that his former boss is now up for a promotion. Finally a chance to confront his former boss appears right before him, what action will the protagonist Kanoko Makoto take?

[From [url=https://syuntada.com/boss/soga.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
被自己尊敬甚至心生一丝敬佩的信任上司背叛、抛弃，主角突然被她降职调职。

有传言称他的前任老板即将升职。面对前任老板的机会终于出现在眼前，主角鹿子真将采取什么行动？

[来自[url=https://syuntada.com/boss/soga.html]官方网站[/url]]
